notes: Only for a task assigned to the agent. Refused with HTTP 409 {"error":"open_children","children":[{"task","title"}]} while the task has open children or unanswered questions, with not_assigned for a task not assigned to the persona and lease_held while another session holds it. summary is at most limits.summary (7950) code points. Otherwise posts the summary, ends the lease and lands provisional: the owner sees "Done by <agent>, confirm?" and confirms or keeps it open. Repeating it while unresolved returns the same completion. request_id (optional, a UUID the client generates once per intended write) makes a retry safe: the same request_id with the same body from the same connection returns the original response and applies nothing; the same request_id with a different body is refused with receipt_collision.
